create_external_value_sensor: create an ExternalValueSensor with a name and initial numpy array value
set_sensor_value: set a new numpy array value on an ExternalValueSensor instance
get_sensor_observables: get the observables dictionary from an ExternalValueSensor instance
get_sensor_name: get the name property string from an ExternalValueSensor instance
